# Somer Industrial Projects (SIP)

> Somer Industrial Projects (SIP) is an independent engineering consultancy determined to help Middle Eastern Business through Strategy Consulting, Sourcing, and knowledge-based training.

## Core Capabilities
- **Engineering Services & Training:** Supporting international companies in executing complex engineering projects; specialized workshops in Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Flow Metering, Control Valves & Actuators, Refinery Operations (economics, feedstocks, planning), Control Systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and HVAC.
- **Business & Management:** Assessing industrial projects within commercial and financial context; training in Banking & Finance, Letters of Credit, Management (HR, PR, change management), and specialized English for Oil & Gas, Business, and Law.
- **Procurement & Sourcing:** Sourcing vital machinery and automation systems including Instrumentation & Gauging Systems, Transmitters & Control Valves, Safety Relief Valves, Drilling Machineries, and Pipeline Equipment.
- **Feasibility & Safety (HSE & IT):** Transitioning companies from exploration to production; certified Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Training, risk assessment, and modern IT integration.

## Key Industrial Sectors Served
- Energy Utilities and Chemicals
- Water and Effluent Treatment
- Healthcare Infrastructure
- IT Services & Industrial Automation
- Security Services (CCTV, Fiber Optics, Surveillance)

## International Strategic Partners
- **Quantum Technologies:** Control and instrumentation engineering services, installation supervision, and commissioning.
- **Ascendant Technologies Ltd.:** Specialist Valve Automation Centre for global Oil & Gas.
- **National Safety Council (NSC):** Premier source for Safety, Health & Environmental (HSE) training and consultancy.
- **IES:** Integrated automation provider (PLC, DCS, SCADA, telecommunications) across power generation, refineries, and cement plants.
- **ATenergy:** E&P business development, exploration, and resource management consultancy.
- **Skills2Learn:** Award-winning interactive e-learning and technology-based training solutions.
- **Square Acre:** London procurement practice sourcing spares and machinery for Mining, Oil & Gas.
- **Beehive Consulting Group:** Australian mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic consulting engineering.
- **EWA Inc.:** British building management systems (BMS) specialist focusing on energy sustainability and engineering projects in Iraq.
- **Seridium GmbH:** Swiss contracting company active in Piping Products, Power Products, and Metal Raw Materials.
